// The cold and warm search of v4.0 over the index TestNightGrow left
// (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "Medidas definitivas a 1M,
// segunda parte (a)", pre-registered on 2026-11-28): TestNightTimed times it
// with the loop of TestDiskTimed, and TestNightLayout lays its vectors out.
//
// Parameters, from the environment, besides those of TestNightGrow and of
// TestNightPoints:
//   - PE_POINTS: the JSON TestNightPoints wrote, with the points to time.
//   - PE_OUT: the JSON written after every point.
//   - PE_PASSES: the timed warm passes of every point and thread count (3).
//   - PE_COLD: how many of the first queries are searched cold (500).
//   - PE_DROP: the shell command that drops the cache of the files of the
//     system, run with the index closed before every cold batch. Without it
//     nothing is timed cold.
//   - PE_TIMEDTHREADS: the thread counts, with commas (1,8).
//   - PE_QUIET and PE_MAXWAIT (TestNightLayout): the seconds the segments of
//     the store must stay as they are, and the most it waits for that (60 and
//     900).

// nightLatencies is the latencies of a set of queries, as TestDiskTimed gives
// them: the percentiles, and the parts of the mean.
type nightLatencies struct {
	Queries int     `json:"queries"`
	P50     float64 `json:"p50ms"`
	P95     float64 `json:"p95ms"`
	P99     float64 `json:"p99ms"`
	Mean    float64 `json:"meanms"`
	// QPS is the queries over the time they took all together.
	QPS float64 `json:"qps"`
	// The parts of the mean latency: the centroid graph, the wait for the
	// blocks, the scan and the ranking of what they hold, and the rescore.
	CentroidMs float64 `json:"centroidms"`
	FetchMs    float64 `json:"fetchms"`
	VisitMs    float64 `json:"visitms"`
	RescoreMs  float64 `json:"rescorems"`
	Loads      float64 `json:"loads"`
	// Granted is the concurrency budget a query ran with, on average.
	Granted float64 `json:"granted"`
}

func nightLatenciesOf(latencies []time.Duration, stats []diskSearchStats, wall time.Duration) nightLatencies {
	toMs := func(d time.Duration) float64 { return float64(d) / float64(time.Millisecond) }
	n := float64(len(latencies))
	sorted := make([]float64, len(latencies))
	out := nightLatencies{Queries: len(latencies)}
	for i, l := range latencies {
		sorted[i] = toMs(l)
		out.Mean += toMs(l) / n
		out.CentroidMs += toMs(stats[i].CentroidTime) / n
		out.FetchMs += toMs(stats[i].FetchTime) / n
		out.VisitMs += toMs(stats[i].VisitTime) / n
		out.RescoreMs += toMs(stats[i].RescoreTime) / n
		out.Loads += float64(stats[i].Postings) / n
		out.Granted += float64(stats[i].Budget) / n
	}
	slices.Sort(sorted)
	// The percentile as TestDiskTimed takes it (percentileOf).
	at := func(q float64) float64 {
		if len(sorted) == 0 {
			return 0
		}
		return sorted[max(0, min(len(sorted)-1, int(math.Ceil(q*float64(len(sorted))))-1))]
	}
	out.P50, out.P95, out.P99 = at(0.50), at(0.95), at(0.99)
	if wall > 0 {
		out.QPS = n / wall.Seconds()
	}
	return out
}

// nightTimedPoint is the index at one operating point with one thread count.
type nightTimedPoint struct {
	Target  float64 `json:"target"`
	EF      int     `json:"ef"`
	Threads int     `json:"threads"`
	Recall  float64 `json:"recall"`
	// Warm has every timed pass over all the queries, after an untimed one.
	Warm []nightLatencies `json:"warm"`
	// Cold is the queries of all the cold batches together, ColdHalves the
	// two halves of the batches apart, ColdFirst the first query of every
	// batch and ColdRest the others (with one thread).
	Cold       *nightLatencies  `json:"cold,omitempty"`
	ColdHalves []nightLatencies `json:"coldHalves,omitempty"`
	ColdFirst  *nightLatencies  `json:"coldFirst,omitempty"`
	ColdRest   *nightLatencies  `json:"coldRest,omitempty"`
	// ColdBatches is the cold batches and ColdBatch their size; ColdRecall
	// the recall of the cold queries, a part of all of them.
	ColdBatches int     `json:"coldBatches,omitempty"`
	ColdBatch   int     `json:"coldBatch,omitempty"`
	ColdRecall  float64 `json:"coldRecall,omitempty"`
	// ReopenMs is the mean time to open the index after the cache is
	// dropped, and IndexBytes what warming the indexes of its segments reads.
	ReopenMs   float64 `json:"reopenms,omitempty"`
	IndexBytes int64   `json:"indexBytes,omitempty"`
}

type nightTimedResult struct {
	Dir       string   `json:"dir"`
	Dataset   string   `json:"dataset"`
	CacheMode string   `json:"cacheMode"`
	Meta      growMeta `json:"meta"`
	Queries   int      `json:"queries"`
	K         int      `json:"k"`
	Procs     int      `json:"gomaxprocs"`
	Drop      string   `json:"drop"`
	OpenSecs  float64  `json:"openSeconds"`
	HeapInuse uint64   `json:"heapInuse"`
	// Segments is the segments of every bucket of the store, and DirBytes
	// what the index takes on disk.
	Segments map[string]int    `json:"segments"`
	DirBytes int64             `json:"dirBytes"`
	Points   []nightTimedPoint `json:"points"`
}

// nightSegments counts the segments of every bucket under the store of dir.
func nightSegments(dir string) (map[string]int, error) {
	buckets, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(dir, "lsm"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := map[string]int{}
	for _, bucket := range buckets {
		if !bucket.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		found, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "lsm", bucket.Name(), "segment-*.db"))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[bucket.Name()] = len(found)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// nightOpen is the index of a directory open with no cycle and no
// maintenance, as TestNightPoints opens it.
type nightOpen struct {
	p  *Persistent
	st *nightStore
}

func openNightIndex(t *testing.T, dir string, logger logrus.FieldLogger, uc ent.UserConfig) *nightOpen {
	t.Helper()
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return &nightOpen{p: p, st: st}
}

func (o *nightOpen) close(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context) {
	t.Helper()
	require.NoError(t, o.p.Shutdown(ctx))
	require.NoError(t, o.st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
}

// TestNightTimed times the index TestNightGrow left at the operating points
// TestNightPoints found, with the loop of TestDiskTimed: at each point and
// with each thread count, a warm pass nobody times and PE_PASSES timed ones
// over all the queries; and, with PE_DROP, the first PE_COLD queries cold, in
// batches of 10 (twice the threads with more than one), the index closed and
// the cache dropped before each. Every query takes its concurrency budget
// from the admission limiter of a node, as in a shard.
func TestNightTimed(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, pointsFile, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_POINTS"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || pointsFile == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR, PE_POINTS and PE_OUT given")
	}
	const k = 10
	ctx := context.Background()
	passes := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_PASSES", 3))
	coldQueries := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_COLD", 500))
	drop := os.Getenv("PE_DROP")
	var threadCounts []int
	for _, field := range strings.Split(nightEnv("PE_TIMEDTHREADS", "1,8"), ",") {
		threads, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(field))
		require.NoError(t, err, "PE_TIMEDTHREADS")
		threadCounts = append(threadCounts, threads)
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(pointsFile)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var found nightPoints
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &found))
	require.NotEmpty(t, found.Points, "%s has no point", pointsFile)

	queries, truth, trainRows := readNightQueries(t, datasetDir, k)
	require.Equal(t, found.DenseIDs, nightTruthIDs(truth, trainRows), "the points were found with other doc ids (PE_DENSE)")
	if limit := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_QUERIES", 0)); limit > 0 && limit < len(queries) {
		queries, truth = queries[:limit], truth[:limit]
	}
	require.Equal(t, found.Queries, len(queries), "the points were found over other queries")
	coldQueries = min(coldQueries, len(queries))

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	require.Equal(t, found.CacheMode, uc.RQ.CacheMode, "the points were found with another cache mode")

	begin := time.Now()
	index := openNightIndex(t, dir, logger, uc)
	opened := time.Since(begin)
	closed := false
	defer func() {
		if !closed {
			index.close(t, ctx)
		}
	}()
	runtime.GC()
	var mem runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem)
	segments, err := nightSegments(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	dirBytes, err := nightDirBytes(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	index.p.mu.RLock()
	result := &nightTimedResult{
		Dir: dir, Dataset: datasetDir, CacheMode: uc.RQ.CacheMode, Meta: index.p.g.meta, Queries: len(queries), K: k,
		Procs: runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), Drop: drop, OpenSecs: opened.Seconds(), HeapInuse: mem.HeapInuse,
		Segments: segments, DirBytes: dirBytes,
	}
	index.p.mu.RUnlock()
	t.Logf("opened in %s: heap in use %.1f MB, %d of %d vectors laid out, segments %v", opened.Round(time.Millisecond),
		float64(mem.HeapInuse)/1e6, result.Meta.VectorsLaidOut, result.Meta.Live, segments)

	// Being admitted is part of the query, as it is in a shard.
	limiter := queryadmission.New(prometheus.NewRegistry(), queryadmission.Config{})
	// run searches the given queries with the given number of threads, each
	// thread taking the next query, and tells the latency and the stats of
	// each, the hits and the time of all.
	run := func(which []int, threads int) ([]time.Duration, []diskSearchStats, int, time.Duration) {
		latencies := make([]time.Duration, len(which))
		stats := make([]diskSearchStats, len(which))
		var next, hits atomic.Int64
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		errs := make([]error, threads)
		p := index.p
		clock := time.Now()
		for worker := 0; worker < threads; worker++ {
			wg.Add(1)
			enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for {
					i := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
					if i >= len(which) {
						return
					}
					q := which[i]
					start := time.Now()
					searchCtx, release, err := limiter.Admit(ctx, concurrency.TimesGOMAXPROCS(2))
					if err != nil {
						errs[worker] = err
						return
					}
					stats[i].Budget = concurrency.BudgetFromCtx(searchCtx, 0)
					p.mu.RLock()
					ids, _, err := p.g.search(searchCtx, queries[q], k, &stats[i])
					p.mu.RUnlock()
					release()
					latencies[i] = time.Since(start)
					if err != nil {
						errs[worker] = err
						return
					}
					got := 0
					for _, want := range truth[q] {
						if slices.Contains(ids, want) {
							got++
						}
					}
					hits.Add(int64(got))
				}
			}, logger)
		}
		wg.Wait()
		wall := time.Since(clock)
		for _, err := range errs {
			require.NoError(t, err)
		}
		return latencies, stats, int(hits.Load()), wall
	}
	all := make([]int, len(queries))
	for i := range all {
		all[i] = i
	}
	sum := func(latencies []time.Duration) (total time.Duration) {
		for _, l := range latencies {
			total += l
		}
		return total
	}

	for _, point := range found.Points {
		searching := uc
		searching.EF = point.EF
		require.NoError(t, index.p.UpdateUserConfig(searching, func() {}))
		for _, threads := range threadCounts {
			timed := nightTimedPoint{Target: point.Target, EF: point.EF, Threads: threads}
			// Warm: after a pass that nobody times.
			_, _, hits, _ := run(all, 8)
			timed.Recall = float64(hits) / float64(len(queries)*k)
			require.InDelta(t, point.Recall, timed.Recall, 1e-9, "the recall of the point at ef %d", point.EF)
			for pass := 0; pass < passes; pass++ {
				latencies, stats, _, wall := run(all, threads)
				timed.Warm = append(timed.Warm, nightLatenciesOf(latencies, stats, wall))
			}
			if len(timed.Warm) > 0 {
				order := slices.Clone(timed.Warm)
				slices.SortFunc(order, func(a, b nightLatencies) int {
					switch {
					case a.P50 < b.P50:
						return -1
					case a.P50 > b.P50:
						return 1
					}
					return 0
				})
				warm := order[len(order)/2]
				t.Logf("recall %.2f (ef %d), %d threads, warm, the median pass: p50 %.3f ms, p95 %.3f, p99 %.3f, mean %.3f | "+
					"%.0f QPS | fetch %.3f ms, visit %.3f, rescore %.3f, centroids %.3f | %.2f loads | a budget of %.1f a query",
					point.Target, point.EF, threads, warm.P50, warm.P95, warm.P99, warm.Mean, warm.QPS, warm.FetchMs,
					warm.VisitMs, warm.RescoreMs, warm.CentroidMs, warm.Loads, warm.Granted)
			}

			if drop != "" && coldQueries > 0 {
				batch := 10
				if threads > 1 {
					batch = 2 * threads
				}
				var latencies, firstLatencies, restLatencies []time.Duration
				var stats, firstStats, restStats []diskSearchStats
				var halves [2]struct {
					latencies []time.Duration
					stats     []diskSearchStats
					wall      time.Duration
				}
				var wall, reopen time.Duration
				hits := 0
				for from := 0; from < coldQueries; from += batch {
					which := all[from:min(from+batch, coldQueries)]
					index.close(t, ctx)
					closed = true
					dropped, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "sh", "-c", drop).CombinedOutput()
					require.NoErrorf(t, err, "drop the cache: %s", dropped)
					clock := time.Now()
					index = openNightIndex(t, dir, logger, uc)
					closed = false
					require.NoError(t, index.p.UpdateUserConfig(searching, func() {}))
					timed.IndexBytes, err = warmSegmentIndexes(filepath.Join(dir, "lsm"))
					require.NoError(t, err)
					reopen += time.Since(clock)

					batchLatencies, batchStats, batchHits, batchWall := run(which, threads)
					half := &halves[timed.ColdBatches%2]
					half.latencies, half.stats = append(half.latencies, batchLatencies...), append(half.stats, batchStats...)
					half.wall += batchWall
					latencies, stats = append(latencies, batchLatencies...), append(stats, batchStats...)
					firstLatencies, firstStats = append(firstLatencies, batchLatencies[0]), append(firstStats, batchStats[0])
					restLatencies, restStats = append(restLatencies, batchLatencies[1:]...), append(restStats, batchStats[1:]...)
					wall += batchWall
					hits += batchHits
					timed.ColdBatches++
				}
				cold := nightLatenciesOf(latencies, stats, wall)
				timed.Cold, timed.ColdBatch = &cold, batch
				if threads == 1 {
					// Their time is that of the queries themselves: one at a time.
					first := nightLatenciesOf(firstLatencies, firstStats, sum(firstLatencies))
					rest := nightLatenciesOf(restLatencies, restStats, sum(restLatencies))
					timed.ColdFirst, timed.ColdRest = &first, &rest
				}
				for _, half := range halves {
					timed.ColdHalves = append(timed.ColdHalves, nightLatenciesOf(half.latencies, half.stats, half.wall))
				}
				timed.ColdRecall = float64(hits) / float64(len(latencies)*k)
				timed.ReopenMs = float64(reopen) / float64(time.Millisecond) / float64(timed.ColdBatches)
				t.Logf("recall %.2f (ef %d), %d threads, cold: p50 %.3f ms, p95 %.3f, p99 %.3f, mean %.3f | %.0f QPS | "+
					"fetch %.3f ms, visit %.3f, rescore %.3f | %d batches of %d, halves at p50 %.3f and %.3f ms | "+
					"reopened in %.0f ms", point.Target, point.EF, threads, cold.P50, cold.P95, cold.P99, cold.Mean, cold.QPS,
					cold.FetchMs, cold.VisitMs, cold.RescoreMs, timed.ColdBatches, batch, timed.ColdHalves[0].P50,
					timed.ColdHalves[1].P50, timed.ReopenMs)
			}
			result.Points = append(result.Points, timed)
			writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
		}
	}
}

// nightLayout is what TestNightLayout did to the index.
type nightLayout struct {
	Dir            string         `json:"dir"`
	CacheMode      string         `json:"cacheMode"`
	LaidOutBefore  int            `json:"vectorsLaidOutBefore"`
	LaidOutAfter   int            `json:"vectorsLaidOutAfter"`
	Live           int            `json:"live"`
	LayoutSeconds  float64        `json:"layoutSeconds"`
	WaitSeconds    float64        `json:"waitSeconds"`
	Quiet          bool           `json:"segmentsStoodStill"`
	SegmentsBefore map[string]int `json:"segmentsBefore"`
	SegmentsAfter  map[string]int `json:"segmentsAfter"`
	DirBytesBefore int64          `json:"dirBytesBefore"`
	DirBytesAfter  int64          `json:"dirBytesAfter"`
}

// TestNightLayout lays the vectors of the index TestNightGrow left out in the
// order of their postings, whatever the rule says of when a pass is due, with
// the store and its cycles as a shard has them; and then waits, the index at
// rest, until the segments of the store have stood as they are for PE_QUIET
// seconds, PE_MAXWAIT at most.
func TestNightLayout(t *testing.T) {
	dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if dir == "" || out == "" || os.Getenv("PE_LAYOUT") == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DIR, PE_OUT and PE_LAYOUT given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	quiet := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_QUIET", 60)) * time.Second
	maxWait := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_MAXWAIT", 900)) * time.Second
	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	result := &nightLayout{Dir: dir, CacheMode: uc.RQ.CacheMode}
	var err error
	result.SegmentsBefore, err = nightSegments(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result.DirBytesBefore, err = nightDirBytes(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, true)
	p, err := Open(st.config(dir, logger, 0), uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	shut := func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		st.stopCycles(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}
	p.mu.RLock()
	require.NotNil(t, p.g, "the index has a base")
	result.LaidOutBefore, result.Live = p.g.meta.VectorsLaidOut, p.g.meta.Live
	p.mu.RUnlock()

	clock := time.Now()
	if err := p.layOut(ctx); err != nil {
		shut()
		require.NoError(t, err, "lay the vectors out")
	}
	result.LayoutSeconds = time.Since(clock).Seconds()
	require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
	p.mu.RLock()
	result.LaidOutAfter = p.g.meta.VectorsLaidOut
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	t.Logf("laid out in %.0f s: %d of %d vectors in the order of their postings, %d before", result.LayoutSeconds,
		result.LaidOutAfter, result.Live, result.LaidOutBefore)

	// At rest, with the cycles of the store running: until its segments
	// stand still.
	clock = time.Now()
	last, _ := nightSegments(dir)
	stood := time.Now()
	for time.Since(clock) < maxWait {
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
		now, err := nightSegments(dir)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		same := len(now) == len(last)
		for bucket, count := range now {
			if last[bucket] != count {
				same = false
			}
		}
		if !same {
			last, stood = now, time.Now()
			continue
		}
		if time.Since(stood) >= quiet {
			result.Quiet = true
			break
		}
	}
	result.WaitSeconds = time.Since(clock).Seconds()
	shut()
	result.SegmentsAfter, err = nightSegments(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result.DirBytesAfter, err = nightDirBytes(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	t.Logf("waited %.0f s for the store (stood still: %v): segments %v, %v before", result.WaitSeconds, result.Quiet,
		result.SegmentsAfter, result.SegmentsBefore)
}
